description: This file contains a PHP class 'ModuleBuilderFieldsCest' which defines acceptance tests for SuiteCRM modules, specifically focusing on module fields, layouts, and related functionalities within the SuiteCRM testing framework using Codeception. The tests include creating modules, adding fields of various types (relate, HTML, integer), deploying modules, and testing record relationships with accounts.
